operations.name: Get list of available Collection profiles
operations.description: Get list of available Forensics collection profiles. The list may be narrowed by specifying filter parameter. Profiles are inherited between scopes in both upward and downward directions, e.g. profiles on parent Account and Tenant scopes are returned when querying for a Site scope, and profiles on a Site scopes are returned when querying its parent Account. Bundled profiles are available regardless of requested scqpe. If scope is not specified in filter, the scopes of the requesting user are considered.

responses.description: Success
Invalid user input received. See error details for further information.
Unauthorized access - please sign in and retry.

query.name: accountIds
query.description: List of Account IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: countOnly
query.description: If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of the actual objects.

query.name: cursor
query.description: Cursor position returned by the last request. Use to iterate over more than 1000 items. Example: "YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".

query.name: ids
query.description: A list of collection profiles IDs. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: limit
query.description: Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".

query.name: query
query.description: Keyword to search in Collection profile name / description

query.name: siteIds
query.description: List of Site IDs to filter by. Example: "225494730938493804,225494730938493915".

query.name: skip
query.description: Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000 items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".

query.name: skipCount
query.description: If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up execution time.

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".
